description: Replaces everything in the open circuit with the one described here: an Arduino Uno, one small breadboard, the listed parts placed in breadboard holes, the wires and (optionally) the Arduino code. If no circuit is open, a new one is created. Holes are named like '12e' (columns 1-30, rows a-j; a-e and f-j are the two halves). Rails are T+, T-, B+, B- with an optional column (T-12). Wire ends are holes, rails, uno.PIN (uno.D13, uno.A0, uno.5V, uno.GND1) or ref.pin (led1.anode). `pin` says which leg of the part goes into `at`; the part is rotated until all legs land in holes. See docs/circuit-spec.md for examples.
name: tinkercad_build_circuit
title: Build a circuit
